risks: S01 section 6.4 requires the incoming Review Outcome to be the only previous outcome for non-PASS recovery while section 6.7 says to copy the continuation view; this implementation follows the more specific section 6.4 rule and freezes it in tests and fixtures.

The finalized semantic-rejection flow requires S03 to persist REJECTED separately after normalizing the first Coordinator error and applying the second EXECUTION_FAILED plan; S08 should retain the seam test that prevents a duplicate disposition or terminal plan.
integration_notes: The two original S01 contract requests are resolved by v1-contract-r2, and the JobControl error-closure request is resolved by v1-contract-r3; there are no unresolved contract change requests.
Every DomainCoordinator result is consumed through the public validate_coordinator_plan_result contract and can only expose the trigger-specific non-retryable ApplicationError subset frozen by r3.

For finalized ROUTE, DIAGNOSIS, and REVIEW semantic rejection, S03 must call coordinator_outcome_error_failure, submit the deterministic OUTCOME_INVALID failure through EXECUTION_FAILED with the original source_outcome_id, and persist Outcome processing REJECTED independently; S01's termination plan deliberately has outcome_disposition null.
INVALID_CASE_STATE from an Outcome trigger belongs exclusively to S03's STALE path and must not be normalized into OUTCOME_INVALID or create a terminal failure plan.

Claim competition is outside the S01 domain boundary: S03 must consume claimed=false, job=null, failure_applied=false, failure_code=null as the ordinary negative receipt, reserve failure_applied=true for ASSET_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE, and never introduce a CLAIM_REJECTED exception path.
S03 supplies stable_target_changed after request classification; true has global decision priority and produces NEW_CASE_REQUIRED without a TransitionPlan or input mutation.
A repeated CANCEL_CASE for an already CANCELLED Case is replayed by S03 before Coordinator invocation; a fresh CANCEL_CASE against CANCELLED returns INVALID_CASE_STATE.
CREATE_CASE consumes an S03-built transient NEW snapshot normalized to Case revision 1 and DiagnosisState revision 1; that transient state is not a persisted stable Case.
PENDING redispatch reuses the same Job outside Coordinator; explicit ResumeInterrupted creates the unique same-stage replacement and preserves the source resource and RuntimeBindings sets.

S01 was clean-rebuilt directly from v1-contract-r3 base 99279d082938dce2a0cdd65f99835cf69571ae84 without importing any archived S01 commit into the new ancestry; the implementation tree is path-, blob-, and mode-equivalent to archived implementation 3561b5c57c751de73cfc4eb6b8b7df3364ddc681 for all 22 declared changed files, and handoff/S01.json is introduced only by the final handoff-only commit.
